hotspots.title: AfD surges in Saxony-Anhalt election with far-right extremism fears
hotspots.blurb: The AfD leads polls ahead of Saxony-Anhalt’s state election, with projections of 40-46% support. The party’s potential victory raises fears of far-right governance, economic disruption, and democratic backsliding. Debates center on migration, economic policies, and the party’s ties to extremist elements, with mainstream parties ruling out coalitions with the AfD.
hotspots.affect: The election commands disproportionate attention due to the existential stakes for Germany’s political landscape, with the AfD poised to form its first state government. The discourse is charged with alarm over the normalization of far-right politics, economic warnings, and fears of democratic erosion.

hotspots.title: Vox escalates Ceuta sovereignty crisis against Sánchez
hotspots.blurb: Vox and PP have intensified protests and political pressure over the Ceuta migrant crisis, accusing Spain’s government of treason, inaction, and complicity in Morocco’s alleged ‘invasion.’ The discourse frames the crisis as a threat to national sovereignty, with calls for mass mobilizations, diplomatic ruptures, and legal consequences for Sánchez’s administration.
hotspots.affect: The Ceuta crisis dominates Spanish right-wing discourse, with Vox framing it as a national emergency and existential threat. The affective charge stems from sovereignty fears, anti-immigration rhetoric, and accusations of government betrayal, amplified by cross-party coordination and street-level mobilization.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s Malvinas national address after Trump’s remarks
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei announced a national broadcast to address the Falkland Islands sovereignty dispute, following Donald Trump’s suggestion that the U.S. may reconsider its long-standing neutral stance. Milei’s move frames the issue as a ‘sacred’ national cause, with affective investment in sovereignty, anti-colonialism, and diplomatic triumph narratives.
hotspots.affect: The Malvinas issue commands intense affective investment in Argentina, tied to national identity and historical grievances. Trump’s remarks amplified the discourse, with Milei leveraging the moment to assert sovereignty and rally domestic support, framing it as a diplomatic victory.

The rebellion taps into dissatisfaction with Salvini’s national pivot, debt issues, and perceived abandonment of the party’s federalist roots, with affective framing around betrayal and identity crisis.
hotspots.affect: The internal Lega conflict commands disproportionate attention due to its existential stakes for the party’s future. The rebellion is framed as a struggle for the party’s soul, with affective investment in nostalgia, betrayal, and the threat of electoral irrelevance if Salvini’s leadership is not checked.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen’s RN pushes veil ban referendum in France
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen’s National Rally (RN) has reignited debate over banning Islamic veils in public spaces, proposing a referendum if elected in 2027. The move frames the veil as a symbol of ‘Islamist ideology’ and a threat to French secularism, with affective investment in cultural identity, security, and anti-Islamist mobilization.
hotspots.affect: The veil ban proposal commands disproportionate attention due to its polarizing nature, tapping into deep-seated cultural and religious tensions in France. The discourse is charged with moral panic over national identity, security fears, and the framing of Islam as incompatible with French republican values.
